input_authorities.input: encrypted user_setting record storage and atomic commit for any future flag value; this ADR accepts no runtime record
provider/model/schema/prompt/policy drift invalidation rules and the mandatory deterministic positive-constraint/semantic-adversarial requirement
independent local facet transitions and the disabled OL-REM-010/OL-REM-017 mode/gate boundary this ADR alone completes
reminder-adapter operation ledger, field ownership, and ambiguous-write reconciliation that any future automatic mutation must still satisfy
exact record fields, retention, and prohibited content for any future flag record and the sealed-corpus content prohibition

confirmation_first.create: every reminder creation requires an explicit user action
confirmation_first.update: every evidence-driven service update to a Microsoft artifact requires an explicit user action
confirmation_first.automatic_exception: read-only reconciliation and local review-state updates still run automatically

hybrid.create_eligibility: live narrow-category cases only: explicit promise, explicit directly addressed request, or explicit deterministic attribution, with a valid resolved deadline, high calibrated confidence, deterministic identity, and no quote/delegation/coreference ambiguity
hybrid.update_eligibility: OpenLoops-owned artifact fields only, when later evidence deterministically changes them, no user override or conflict exists, and the update class passed G-AUTO
hybrid.otherwise: every other mutation is proposed for confirmation

automatic.precondition: explicit opt-in and risk disclosure plus G-AUTO-FULL
automatic.create_update_eligibility: every live established loop in the user's enabled non-ambiguous categories whose exact category/confidence/deadline/update stratum independently passed G-AUTO-FULL
automatic.always_review: candidate, ambiguous, identity-ambiguous, delegation-ambiguous, quote-ambiguous, undated, historical/backfill, and stale-write cases always require review in every mode

mode_catalog.mode_change_rule: a mode change is prospective only; no mode silently creates or rewrites a historical batch, closes a loop, deletes an artifact, or communicates with another person; inferred closure and external communication are never automatic in any mode

flip_requires: accountable owner release decision citing that gate evidence
accountable owner release decision citing that gate evidence
user explicit opt-in and risk acknowledgement

flag_topology.effective_mode_rule: the effective mode is always the narrower of the user's selected preference and the modes currently permitted by passed-gate evidence and flipped flags

corpus_governance.location: outside the repository, outside the implementation-LLM's context, and outside the maker workflow
corpus_governance.content: wholly synthetic; never real mailbox content
corpus_governance.split_rule: split by conversation family, never by message row; no family straddles a split
corpus_governance.sample_size_rule: per-stratum positive and negative sample sizes are declared before evaluation and support the claimed lower-bound confidence procedure
corpus_governance.confidence_rule: a point estimate alone never substitutes for a declared lower bound; each release threshold is a lower-bound confidence claim
corpus_governance.immutability: corpus content, version, and hashes are immutable once sealed
corpus_governance.tuning_budget: a maximum tuning-attempt budget is pinned before evaluation begins; exceeding it requires a fresh corpus version, never a silent extra round against the same sealed data
corpus_governance.contamination_checks: no sealed-corpus example, label, or identifier reaches a public development fixture, the repository, or any maker/implementation-LLM context
corpus_governance.observation_framing: zero observed unintended mutations in at least 10,000 events is reported strictly as a finite-sample observation, never a guarantee

calibration_invalidation.effect: invalidates the corresponding calibration; any already-flipped flag reverts to confirmation_first pending re-evaluation
calibration_invalidation.post_drift_action: only an explicit review-only replay is permitted; no automatic terminal, Graph, Office, or reminder mutation follows a drift-triggered reversion

rollback_boundary.trigger: user request at any time, regardless of flag state, gate status, or pending evaluation
prohibited: mutation of a prior loop transition
required additional confirmation or owner approval to take effect

evaluation_privacy_boundary.profiling_claim: prohibited; no reported metric implies persistent user profiling

prohibited: retroactive historical batch creation or rewrite

phase_gating.fully_automatic: requires G-AUTO-FULL plus explicit opt-in and risk acknowledgement

mode_change_boundary.fallback: the user can revert to confirmation_first instantly and unilaterally at any time
